description: Write clear, warm, family-facing communication for K-12: class newsletters, parent/guardian letters and emails, conference talking points, and progress-report narrative comments. Use this whenever a teacher or administrator needs to communicate home — phrasings like 'write a newsletter about…', 'a letter to parents explaining…', 'an email to a family about…', 'talking points for conferences', or 'comments for report cards'. It writes in plain, jargon-free, translation-friendly language at an accessible reading level, keeps a respectful strengths-based tone, and is careful to protect student privacy. Make sure to use this whenever the audience is families/guardians rather than students or staff. CRITICAL: use placeholder names only and never include real student data or sensitive details; for individual messages, keep specifics general and flag for the teacher to personalize. Do NOT use it for staff/PD communication (professional-learning) or instructional materials (lesson-planner).
